critical_findings.title: Accent overexposure on notifications — no severity encoding
critical_findings.fix: Add a severity field to NotificationItem and key border-left-color to --danger (error/offline), --accent (warning), neutral (info); reserve bare accent for warnings

critical_findings.title: Dark-only theme — no light mode for paid desktop tier
critical_findings.fix: Define a second token value set under [data-theme="light"] with a header toggle; re-verify the documented contrast pairs for the light ground

critical_findings.title: Touch-target drift: 44px nav items vs 32px switcher and Mark read button
critical_findings.fix: Extract a shared --control-height: 44px token and apply to .cf-account-switcher and .cf-mark-seen

critical_findings.title: No typographic identity — system stack only, plus 12/13px near-duplicate scale steps
critical_findings.fix: Collapse --text-xs/--text-sm into one 12px step; introduce a characterful display face for brand + view titles over the system body stack

critical_findings.title: Pure neutral grays — zero hue bias toward the amber accent
critical_findings.fix: Nudge surface/border/muted tokens 2-3 degrees warm toward #f59e0b; keep documented contrast ratios valid

critical_findings.title: Zero motion — hover states snap, live notifications pop in with no enter cue
critical_findings.fix: Add 120ms ease-out transitions on interactive hover/active states and a ~150ms fade/translate on notification item enter (plain CSS, no Framer Motion needed)

critical_findings.title: Magic number calc(100vh - 14rem) caps the notification list
critical_findings.fix: Make .cf-notifications a min-height:0 flex column and let the list flex-fill with its own overflow-y: auto

recommendations.action: Add severity encoding to notifications (severity field + conditional border-left color)
Add light theme: second token set under [data-theme="light"] + header toggle, re-verify contrast pairs
Unify control heights on a 44px token and collapse the 12/13px type-scale step
Add CSS micro-transitions for hover states and notification enter animation
Warm neutral grays 2-3 degrees toward the amber accent
Replace calc(100vh - 14rem) with a flex-based fill layout for the notification list

roadmap_suggestions.title: Notification severity system
roadmap_suggestions.description: Severity field from daemon events + visual ranking in the panel; prerequisite for any alerting UX

roadmap_suggestions.title: Light/dark theme support
roadmap_suggestions.description: Token-level second palette + toggle; expected of a paid desktop tier

roadmap_suggestions.title: Motion polish pass
roadmap_suggestions.description: CSS-only micro-interactions for hover states and notification enter; no Framer Motion dependency needed at this scope
